## Description

Briefly describe the change and the motivation behind it.

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change fixing an issue)
- [ ] Schema or calculations improvement
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] CI/CD or developer tooling enhancement
- [ ] Mock client or offline test improvement

## Validation

- [ ] Unit tests pass (`make test` or `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v`)
- [ ] Python syntax validation passed (`make lint`)
- [ ] Pipeline mock dry-run executed successfully (`make demo`)
- [ ] Schema v5.0 invariants preserved in `data/dashboard.json`

## Checklist

- [ ] My code adheres to established project conventions
- [ ] No real credentials, tokens, or private telemetry files are included
- [ ] Documentation has been updated where relevant
